task_id: R-01 / noninvasive in-circuit U2 acquisition review

owner_constraint.statement: Owner will not consider chip removal because of risk on the dense board and requests another method.
owner_constraint.active_scope: Keep chips and leads intact. No chip removal, leg lifting or trace cutting in this plan. Earlier off-board fallback recommendations are historical and outside current scope.

review_correction: 10k/5.6k pull-up results fail to demonstrate reliable unused-U1 deselection, but do not prove all noninvasive alternatives exhausted. No guarantee an in-circuit alternative will succeed.

owner_current_state.Pi: Owner explicitly confirms turned off and physically unplugged.
owner_current_state.access: Owner expects meter access to U1pins1/3 with U2clip retained; actual successful probe access not yet measured.
owner_current_state.wiring: Retain short U2clip and U1pin7 grabber/nominal5.6k resistor; no new drive/jumper.

candidates.name: Unused U1 HOLD#
candidates.documented_behavior: If enabled and applicable to current protocol, pauses communication and releases data outputs without requiring deselection.
candidates.qualification: Function may be disabled by NVCR/EVCRbit4, QIO-SPI or DTR. Need independent U1 wiring, rail/loading/contact qualification and empirical output/read validation. Board independence/function not established; no grounding or register write selected.

candidates.name: Unused U1 dedicated RESET#
candidates.qualification: Independent U1 control/net loading and current device state must be established. Historical breakout-reset readings with successful identification remain unresolved and are not current package-pin validation. No reset assertion selected.

other_board_option.basis: Vendor documents disabling switches via enable control.
other_board_option.limits: Actual CS route and safe accessible control/supply mapping unresolved; prior completed header/U4 scans and inaccessible fine-probing are not restarted. No selector/enable jumper selected.

first_new_checks.procedure: Verify P1pin1-to-pin2 residual0VDC before ohms. Then black at P1headerpin1/VCC, red sequentially actual U1pin1/HOLD# and actual U1pin3/RESET#. Report numerical ohms/OL; retain wiring.
first_new_checks.purpose: Screen for near-zero ties to flash VCC before considering any drive. These in-circuit equivalents do not establish discrete resistor values or independent control from U2.
first_new_checks.later_requirements: If viable, establish U1/U2 control-net independence using genuinely accessible verified endpoints, qualify driver/loading and secure contact, then separately plan limited no-clock control. No generic scan or speculative ground jumper.

agent_hardware_actions: None. Source/evidence review and repository maintenance only; no GPIO/SPI/SSH/programmer/array access or new powered experiment.
